name: Incline Reverse-Grip Push-Up
steps: Grip the edge of a stable bench with hands shoulder-width apart and fingers angled toward your feet.
Step back into a plank and brace your abdomen.
Bend your elbows alongside your ribs and lower your chest toward the bench.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your arms back to the start.
tips: Turn your fingers slightly outward if pointing them straight back feels uncomfortable on your wrists.
Keep your elbows tucked closely to your ribs throughout each repetition.
